about.text: Sometimes known as the "younger sister" of Oscypek and the two are occasionally confused. The cheese is often made in the shape of animals, hearts, or decorative wreaths.

sources.text: Smoked, decorative 'younger sister' of Oscypek made from leftover bundz; EU PDO since 2009 (en Wikipedia: PDO, not PGI); firm with soft elastic inside
